newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher on fund shortcovering.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher on fund shortcovering.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended higher Monday on fund shortcovering and follow-through buying to Friday's sharply higher close, traders said.
"Funds were buyers," a trader said. "It was mostly shortcovering. Refco was buying, ING and Dean Witter were selling."
Weather remained supportive as below-normal temperatures hit Texas growing regions. Traders noted warm temperatures were needed to dry up water-logged fields.
Cash trade was said to be quiet and prices were mostly steady as most dealers wrapped up old business and there was little new demand.
"Most people in the cash market are dealing with past business," a trader said. "They're busy loading and shipping but there's not much news coming out of there."
Rice ended 10 to two cents higher, with May up 10 cents at $11.74 per cwt.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 600 lots against Friday's actual volume of 800 lots.
